parts.name: Sigmoid colon, rectum and anal canal (one Z-Anatomy object, 'Sigmoid colon')

appendix_base.name: Base of the appendix (appendix surface point nearest the ascending colon)
appendix_base.derived: baked 'appendix' vertex closest to the 'colon.ascending_colon' mesh (0.04 cm gap)

appendix_tip.name: Tip of the appendix (appendix surface point farthest from its base)

right_colic_flexure.name: Right colic (hepatic) flexure (midpoint of the closest ascending-transverse colon surface pair)
right_colic_flexure.derived: midpoint of the closest vertex pair between baked 'ascending_colon' and 'colon.transverse_colon' (0.10 cm gap)

left_colic_flexure.name: Left colic (splenic) flexure (midpoint of the closest transverse-descending colon surface pair)
left_colic_flexure.derived: midpoint of the closest vertex pair between baked 'transverse_colon' and 'colon.descending_colon' (0.05 cm gap)

colon_lowest_point.name: Lowest point of the large intestine (anal end of the sigmoid/rectum object)
colon_lowest_point.derived: baked 'sigmoid_colon_rectum' vertex with the smallest y

ileocolic_junction.name: Ileocolic junction (ascending-colon surface point nearest the ileal end of the small-intestine curve)
ileocolic_junction.derived: baked 'ascending_colon' vertex nearest landmark 'terminal_ileum_end' (0.82 cm away)
